The device uses a two-wire I<sup>2</sup>C compatible serial interface and operates from a single 2.7V to 5.5V power supply.

This device has an on-board programmable gain amplifier (PGA). The user can select the PGA gain of x1, x2, x4, or x8 before the analog-to-digital conversion takes place. This allows the MCP3421 device to convert a smaller input signal with high resolution.
